name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo Alves is a seasoned race engineer with over two decades of experience in motorsport. Growing up in São Paulo, he was captivated by the roar of Formula One cars at Interlagos, fueling a lifelong passion for racing. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ricardo started his career in Brazilian stock car racing before transitioning to international GT series. He joined Full Time Sports five years ago, bringing a pragmatic and methodical approach to car setup and strategy.

Ricardo's focus is always on data analysis and driver feedback, meticulously working to optimize performance. He's known for his ability to remain calm under pressure and make decisive calls during races. While not the flashiest engineer, his consistency and reliability have made him a valuable asset to the team. His commitment to continuous improvement is unwavering, always seeking marginal gains to enhance the car's performance.

He is considered a competent and experienced race engineer with Technical 55/100, Management 56/100 and Innovation 52/100. He also has the lone_wolf trait.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of medium height with a slight build, Ricardo always looks focused and analytical.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking a specific brand of Brazilian coffee before every race.
